mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances when INDPRO increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a disinflationary environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL declines > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 jobs in a month signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 300k jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% each month-over-month signals a strengthening demand side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 2% MoM
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2%.
